input: Search the web for kids' "summer program" offerings (programs that don't call themselves camps) for kids and teens in Asheville and Buncombe County, NC. Use that wording in your searches, not just "camp", and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: Weeklong residential programs for rising high school sophomores through seniors; 2027 interest form available.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: COMPASS academic immersion for rising high school sophomores through college freshmen, June 20–24, 2027.

candidates.name: Horizons at Carolina Day School
candidates.note: Tuition-free six-week Summer Academy combining academics, arts, swimming and field trips for K–8 students.

candidates.name: City of Asheville
candidates.note: CAYLA places local high school students in summer jobs with weekly leadership, financial-literacy and career workshops.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: WORX Project offers free summer career-connected learning and skilled-trades activities for public-school middle schoolers.

candidates.name: Center Stage AVL
candidates.note: Summer-only dance classes and short intensives; July 2026 offerings included modern and hip-hop technique.

candidates.name: The Performing Arts Company of Asheville
candidates.note: Summer Dance Intensive for ages 8–18 ran August 3–7, 2026.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: Weeklong youth conferences combine study, worship and recreation; summer 2027 conferences announced.

candidates.name: Project Lighten Up
candidates.note: Summer Learning Academy blends educational and recreational activities; listed among local student summer programs in May 2025.

candidates.name: Buncombe County Public Libraries
candidates.note: Countywide Summer Learning Program for children; 2027 theme announced as Mysteries Await at Your Library.
